HubSpot

Give every qualified enquiry a clear owner and next step.

HOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

HubSpot provides CRM records and connected sales and marketing tools. MoreSpace can model the enquiry-to-revenue process, organize contact and deal data, and create consistent handoffs so the team can see ownership, qualification, next actions, and the relationship between acquisition and pipeline outcomes.

Useful outputs

  • Configured contact and deal structures with clear ownership
  • Reviewed routing rules and operational sales follow-up views
  • Pipeline scorecards and a documented CRM operating process

Where we can apply it

  • Qualified form enquiry → contact match → deal creation → assigned sales owner.
  • Outreach response → qualification task → stage update → pipeline review.
  • CRM stage history → agreed metric model → dashboard → weekly sales decisions.
01

Use case 1

Build an enquiry pipeline with qualification criteria, ownership, and next actions.

02

Use case 2

Connect approved form and outreach events with contact and deal records.

03

Use case 3

Create sales dashboards that explain stage progression and response performance.

Inputs we need

  • Sales stages, qualification rules, and customer record definitions
  • Authorized contact sources and existing account or deal records
  • Team roles, handoff owners, and follow-up expectations

Delivery sequence

  • Agree stage entry and exit criteria before configuring the pipeline.
  • Clean starting records and test scoped integrations and owner assignment.
  • Validate permissions and report calculations with the sales team.

Expert review points

  • Review duplicate records and field updates before activating synchronization.
  • Approve routing responsibilities and stage definitions with the people using them.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
